next.reason: 1985: "USE AFTER STANDARD {EXCEPTION|ERROR} PROCEDURE ON {file-name-1 …|OUTPUT|EXTEND}, with AFTER underlined"; 2023: "USE [GLOBAL] AFTER STANDARD … ON {file-name-1…|INPUT|OUTPUT|I-O|EXTEND}; AFTER is not underlined". 2023 Format 1 adds INPUT, I-O and optional GLOBAL, and makes AFTER an optional word, so it accepts programs the 1985 Report Writer format refuses.
